definitions.gloss: to misunderstand, to misconstrue, to get the wrong idea
definitions.explanation: To understand something incorrectly or form a wrong impression. Can refer to misunderstanding words, intentions, situations, or people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧しないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧ような⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧はしない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better not to phrase things in a way that invites misunderstanding.

notes:
Very common in everyday conversation and written Japanese. The noun form ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧ is frequently used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to invite misunderstanding
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to clear up a misunderstanding
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give a wrong impression
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: a misunderstanding arises
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧されやすい: easy to be misunderstood

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勘違|かんちが}い→勘違い：17609_kanchigai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be mistaken, to get confused — more casual, often about factual mix-ups
- {誤解|ごかい}する: to misunderstand — can involve deeper misinterpretation of meaning or intention
